data.one_liner: Customizable scrollable date picker for Flutter
data.what_it_does: Provides a scrollable widget to select dates with support for multiple locales and touch interaction. It can be embedded in any Flutter UI and offers extensive styling options.
use_when: You need a date picker that works on Android, iOS and Web
You want to customize the appearance and behavior of the picker
You require support for many languages and locale-specific ordering
avoid_when: You need a native platform date picker with system dialogs
You have very strict performance constraints and want the smallest possible widget
strengths: Supports many locales and language-specific month names
Touch-based date changing and looping options

alternatives.name: calendar_date_picker2
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a similar scrollable date picker with a slightly different API and styling options
